about: What Joel has said stays as it is in the Bad Trips guide, and the cuts he meant: no card flags, fixes or puts these back (tools/humanization/keep_as_is.py, gate E340). Started 2026-11-04 from his answers to round 1 (review/r01/ANSWERS-R01-20261103-1859.json), his messages of 2026-11-03 (experiments/t01-answers/) and round 2 (review/r02/ANSWERS-R02-20261104-1026.json). His other edits, with the strings that prove they are in, are in OWNER-EDITS.json. The quotes are in the guide's characters after the standard swap (humanize/h01/swap.py): straight quote marks, spaced en dashes.

keep.quote: Hello, Lovey Bunny! I hope you are presently well, and if not, I pray that you
keep.what: A soft greeting in the middle of a practical guide reads like a stray tone shift a pass would move to the top or cut; he wants it where it is, where the guide turns to shadow work.
keep.joel: yeah i wanted to keep this at the part where we are talking about dealing iwth actual shadow work rather than the physical triage since that's more of a mechanical type of prose needing less softness
